headline: Argentina Country Risk Hits Multi-Year High Amid Global Bond Declines
summary: Argentina's country risk indicator climbed for six consecutive sessions to 939 basis points, marking its highest level in over a year, as Global bonds fell 0.3%.
why: Emerging market country risk spreads measure the yield premium investors demand to hold sovereign debt over U.S. Treasuries, directly reflecting sovereign default risk and macroeconomic stress.

impacts.name: Argentina Country Risk Index
impacts.why: Rising yields on Argentine Global bonds directly push up the JP Morgan country risk spread.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Global bond declines and persistent economic uncertainty pushed the country risk spread higher for six consecutive sessions.
